paper.title: Structure of Intermediate Wakimoto Modules
paper.abstract: We show that our construction of boson type realizations of affine $\mathfrak{sl}(n+1)$ in terms of intermediate Wakimoto modules gives representations that are generically isomorphic to certain Verma type modules. We then use this identification to obtain information about the submodule structure of intermediate Wakimoto modules
